title: Entity-anchored retrieval for entity-scoped current-state query/search

baselines.note: same brain, same query op call, key off

preregistration: README.md in garrytan/gbrain@9a8cfb9f7, before any gated run

models.selection: B-suite fixed reader; gbrain default embedding

gates.1: seeded appended-corrections workload, seeds 42/7/1234, query op expansion off, reader at 200 tokens (sensitivity: 16 rows); pass if in every seed key-on accuracy is higher or freshness lag lower, and accuracy lower in no seed
gates.2: NamedThingBench, relational retrieval-quality, LongMemEval nightly through the query op key on vs off (keyword-only); pass if no question top-10 recall is lower with the key on
gates.3: harness lane: LongMemEval knowledge-update, PersonaMem, BEAM dev slices, then validation (not run here)

decision_rule: default-on only if gates 1 and 2 pass here and gate 3 passes in the harness lane; off until then
